nom: PLANTIFIQUE Kojic Acid & Turmeric Cleansing Pads for Dark Spots

segments.mature: The one reviewer who identifies as middle-aged, dealing with hormonal acne, reports it doesn't dry her skin out and clears her acne faster than prescribed creams did.

concerns.dehydration: The one reviewer who addresses this reports it doesn't dry her skin out at all, even using it twice a day.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer in this set reports irritation; several describe the pads as gentle, leaving skin clean and smooth rather than harsh.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report their dark spots, melasma, or dullness faded with regular use, in one case within a single day and in another from a 10 down to a 5 in severity over a couple of months alongside retinol and sunscreen; one reviewer, however, saw little to no change in her dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: The one reviewer who addresses acne reports it doesn't trigger flare-ups and clears her hormonal acne faster than anything else she has tried, including prescribed acne creams.

aspects.libelle: 100 pads per jar, good value for the price
Foams up well on a damp face
Included tongs are small and fiddly
Wish it had more exfoliating texture on one side
Multi-use beyond the face (arms, hands, body)
Leaves skin feeling clean and velvety soft

extraits.texte: I didn’t see much of a change in the dark spots on my face. Probably would not buy again.

Ive had a random dark spot that looked like a constant smudge of dirt on my cheek for years now. I used these for one day, ONE DAY and its already noticeably faded where you dont notice it at all and it doesn't pick up in a picture when I take one. Im genuinely shocked.

extraits.titre: Good results so far, pleasant to use.
extraits.texte: Does a good job of reducing my daughter's melasma when used with retinol cream and sunscreen every day. Second time purchasing. On a scale of 1-10, the spots have gone from 10 to 5 in a couple of months, and are still diminishing.

I use these twice a day as part of my routine and they dont dry out my face at all, i love the little glow they give my skin and they fact they dont make my acne break out and flare up. I am middle aged with hormonal acne that comes and goes like my children attitude and these just work for me, help clear it up faster then anything else i have used and i have been on perscribed acne creams and none of them helped at all. Cant fault these, love the packaging but not a fan of the tiny tongs.

I really like these cleansing pads. They are easy to use and leave my skin feeling clean, smooth and refreshed without being too harsh. I like that they contain kojic acid, turmeric, niacinamide, vitamin C and ceramides. With regular use, my skin looks brighter and more even. The pads are also convenient and easy to use. Overall, a good addition to my skincare routine.

Really love these cleansing pads. I had a different brand before, but these from Plantifique really suds up, and one pad can be used for face, arms, hands and more. I'm starting to notice that some of the dullness is going away, and my face just looks a whole lot clearer overall.
